Role: Machine Learning Engineer - Fraud
Company: PayJoy
Company category: Fintech
Location: Mexico City, CDMX
Work model: Hybrid
Application language: en
JD fidelity: full (40/100)
JD generation eligible: true

Technologies / capabilities: Python; Machine Learning; Fraud detection; ML lifecycle; Model deployment; Model monitoring; AWS; Docker; Databricks; LLMs; Credit risk; Data Science
Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.; At least three years in data science, machine learning engineering, data engineering or a closely related role with production-level code and maintained ML models in production.; High proficiency in Python and related data and machine learning libraries and frameworks.; Strong knowledge of the full ML lifecycle from extraction and feature engineering through serving and monitoring for live and batch processing.; Experience with cloud providers, preferably AWS, and containerization such as Docker.; Strong English communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing requirements.; Fraud detection or financial-market ML experience is a plus; LLMs, graph databases and Databricks are additional pluses.
Responsibilities: Design, build and deploy machine learning models for fraud detection use cases across PayJoy's product suite.; Deliver production-ready ML models optimized for scale and improve them continuously from stakeholder feedback and observed production performance.; Extend fraud decisioning infrastructure to new entity types, construct new rules and support greater scale.; Clean, preprocess and engineer features from large and complex datasets to improve predictive accuracy and performance.; Write production-level code with documentation, testing and peer review.; Lead testing, cost-benefit analysis and integration of new data sources to improve model robustness.; Partner with ML Platform and Tooling teams on scalable feature generation, extraction, deployment and monitoring processes.; Collaborate with global Fraud, Engineering, Product and Risk teams to deliver data science products across multiple markets.

Source fit score: 96/100
Source fit summary: Es la vacante con mejor alineación de negocio: fraude, crédito, modelos productivos y fintech en CDMX.
Source strengths: Fintech con foco directo en fraude y riesgo crediticio.; Responsabilidad de desarrollar, optimizar y desplegar modelos de ML en producción.; Aprovecha experiencia bancaria, detección de fraude, scoring, Python/SQL y modelos end-to-end.
Source gaps: El título es Machine Learning Engineer y puede cargar más hacia infraestructura que hacia ciencia de datos pura.; La publicación oficial no muestra rango salarial.
